input.question: The premises of this running plan changed (trigger below). Reconsider the plan as a whole and choose one action: reintegrate_in_plan (bring the change into this plan with new or amended deliverables and tasks, re-entering execute), split_change (deliver the plan as several pull requests or move part of it to a follow-up plan), defer_to_follow_up_plan (drop the affected part from this plan), wait_for_prerequisite (hold this plan until a named prerequisite lands, then resume), rebase_and_reverify_only, or hand_back (the plan cannot continue within its guards). Then give the revised outline and the new tasks so that they can be submitted like a first plan.
input.facts:
Plan: FAPI 2.0 client controls for the BFF — PAR, private_key_jwt and DPoP on token-sheriff-client 0.9.6
Summary: The BFF stops sending authorization parameters through the browser. It pushes every authorization request through PAR and binds the tokens it obtains to one DPoP key shared by the code exchange, the per-scope login flows and the refresh grant. A token response that is not bound to that key is refused: the login fails, or the session ends, and no session runs on an unbound token. Both hold in every BFF configuration. rationale.description: why this action, in at most five sentences

verification.description: command or criterion that proves the task

prerequisite.description: for wait_for_prerequisite: what must land before the plan resumes

target.rationale: A required reviewer cannot review a 117-file change and cannot be waived; splitting along code versus documentation keeps each pull request reviewable while main stays green after each merge.

items.description: first pull request: production code, tests, integration stack, and only the documents a contract test pins (under 100 files)
second pull request (or follow-up plan): the remaining documentation, opened after the first has merged so main stays consistent at each step
preserves the full tree on a separate branch before documentation is removed from the first pull request
fixes the 16 Sonar issues on the branch before the split head is reviewed
re-verifies the code-only tree (quality gate and full verify) and requests the required reviewers on the new head
records both pull requests in the plan (outline/tasks), so landing and cleanup cover the second one too

grading.judge: a judge model without tools (claude-sonnet-5-5) sees question, facts, target.items and the answer, and returns the items met with a score from 0 to 1
